net-core.rationale: Recreate network topology (VPC/subnets/routing) as the foundation other resources land on.

db-legacy-crm.rationale: EOL/legacy engine: move to a managed equivalent (e.g. RDS) rather than a straight lift-and-shift; schema/engine compatibility needs validation.

db-orders.rationale: Standard managed-database replatform (self-managed -> RDS-class service) to pick up automated backups/HA.

dns-primary.rationale: Recreate DNS zone in managed DNS; cutover is the last step and the easiest to roll back.

fs-reports.rationale: File share -> object storage; low risk, plan for a protocol change (NFS/SMB clients need to switch to S3 API or a gateway).

job-nightly-etl.rationale: Scheduled job maps directly onto a managed serverless function.

vm-crm-app.rationale: EOL OS: rehosting would carry the unsupported OS into the cloud. Recommend refactoring onto a supported runtime/container image before or during migration.

vm-web-01.rationale: Stateless web/app tier: good candidate for replatforming onto an auto-scaled instance group behind a load balancer.

vm-web-02.rationale: Stateless web/app tier: good candidate for replatforming onto an auto-scaled instance group behind a load balancer.

lb-orders.rationale: Replace with a managed load balancer service.

notes: 2 high-risk resource(s) flagged for extra review before cutover: db-legacy-crm, vm-crm-app.
Plan has 4 wave(s); resources within a wave have no dependency ordering between them and can migrate in parallel.
